text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/repository.py:13:deprecated-method"], "search": "    return Customer.from_orm(record)", "replace": "    return Customer.model_validate(record, from_attributes=True)", "explanation": "`from_orm()` is deprecated in Pydantic v2 (migration.md#changes-to-pydanticbasemodel). Per the same guide, `model_validate` replaces it when `from_attributes=True` is set. Passing `from_attributes=True` as a keyword to `model_validate` enables attribute-based validation for this call without changing the Customer model config, which lives in app/models.py and is outside this edit. Behavior is unchanged for the SimpleNamespace records produced by make_record."}], "notes": "Only one finding in app/repository.py. The single edit replaces the deprecated from_orm call on line 13. The from_attributes flag is passed per call, so no import changes are needed. The Customer model config (adding from_attributes=True in model_config) belongs to app/models.py, which is a separate file in this migration, so it is not touched here. No other v1 APIs appear in this file. make_record uses SimpleNamespace, not Pydantic, so it needs no change."}
